title: Battle of Erzurum (1552)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Erzurum (1552)", at revision 1375355369, opens: "Battle of Erzurum  refers to the campaign of Shah Tahmasp, the second ruler of Safavid Iran, which was carried out in response to the campaigns of Sultan Suleiman to the Safavid lands. The purpose of the campaign was to carry out plunder, obtain prisoners and force peace by destroying the rear of the Ottoman Empire." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q114314710, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1552–1553 military campaign". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
